### CfnProjectProps <a name="CfnProjectProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps"></a>

A PostHog project and its main settings.

Deleting the resource deletes the PostHog project and all of its data (events, persons, recordings, insights, flags and so on); it cannot be undone.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { organizations } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnProjectProps: organizations.CfnProjectProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Project name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.organizationId">organizationId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization the project belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.anonymizeIps">anonymizeIps</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | When true, PostHog drops the IP address from every ingested event. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.autocaptureExceptionsOptIn">autocaptureExceptionsOptIn</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables automatic capture of JavaScript exceptions via the SDK. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.autocaptureOptOut">autocaptureOptOut</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Disables posthog-js autocapture (clicks, page views) when true. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.autocaptureWebVitalsOptIn">autocaptureWebVitalsOptIn</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables automatic capture of Core Web Vitals performance metrics. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.baseCurrency">baseCurrency</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ISO 4217 currency code used for revenue analytics, e.g. EUR. PostHog defaults to USD. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.captureDeadClicks">captureDeadClicks</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables capturing clicks that had no effect. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.capturePerformanceOptIn">capturePerformanceOptIn</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables capturing performance timing and network requests. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.heatmapsOptIn">heatmapsOptIn</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables heatmap recording on pages that use posthog-js. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.productDescription">productDescription</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Short description of what the project is about, used as context by PostHog AI features. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.recordingDomains">recordingDomains</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Origins permitted to record session replays and heatmaps. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.sessionRecordingMinimumDurationMilliseconds">sessionRecordingMinimumDurationMilliseconds</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Skip saving sessions shorter than this many milliseconds. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProjectProps.property.surveysOptIn">surveysOptIn</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Enables displaying surveys via posthog-js on allowed origins. |

### CfnProviderKeyProps <a name="CfnProviderKeyProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps"></a>

A PostHog LLM analytics provider key: an LLM provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ...) that PostHog uses to run LLM-judge evaluations and other LLM analytics features in a project. The key itself is write-only; PostHog only returns a masked form.

```typescript
const cfnProviderKeyProps: llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps = { ... }
```

| --- | --- | --- |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the provider key belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.provider">provider</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyPropsProvider</code> | LLM provider the key is for. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.apiKey">apiKey</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The provider API key. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.apiVersion">apiVersion</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Azure OpenAI API version. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.azureEndpoint">azureEndpoint</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Azure OpenAI endpoint URL. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.baseUrl">baseUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Public HTTPS base URL of an OpenAI-compatible or System One API. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.CfnProviderKeyProps.property.systemOneModel">systemOneModel</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Model ID served by the System One endpoint. |

### CfnProxyRecordProps <a name="CfnProxyRecordProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProxyRecordProps"></a>

A PostHog managed reverse proxy: a custom subdomain you own that proxies PostHog ingestion.

After creation, add a CNAME record from Domain to TargetCname; PostHog then verifies the record and provisions the proxy.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProxyRecordProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { organizations } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'
```

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProxyRecordProps.property.organizationId">organizationId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization that owns the proxy. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.CfnProxyRecordProps.property.rootRedirectUrl">rootRedirectUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to. |

### CfnRetentionRuleProps <a name="CfnRetentionRuleProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps"></a>

A PostHog Logs retention rule: logs matching the rule's filter group are kept for the rule's retention period instead of the environment's default Logs retention.

Rules are evaluated in priority order and the first match wins.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { logs } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnRetentionRuleProps: logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.config">config</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Retention rule configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | User-visible label for this rule. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the retention rule belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.enabled">enabled</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Whether the rule is active. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.priority">priority</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Evaluation order: lower numbers are evaluated first and the first matching rule wins. |

---

##### `config`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="config" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.config"></a>

```typescript
public readonly config: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Retention rule configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString).

Required keys: `retention_days` (integer; must be a retention tier the organization is entitled to) and `filter_group` (a PropertyGroupFilter: an AND/OR tree of property predicates deciding which logs the rule matches), e.g. {"retention_days": 30, "filter_group": {"type": "AND", "values": [{"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "service.name", "operator": "exact", "value": "api"}]}]}}.

---

##### `name`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="name" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.name"></a>

```typescript
public readonly name: string;
```

- *Type:* string

User-visible label for this rule.

---

##### `projectId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="projectId" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.projectId"></a>

```typescript
public readonly projectId: string;
```

- *Type:* string

ID of the PostHog project the retention rule belongs to.

---

##### `enabled`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="enabled" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.enabled"></a>

```typescript
public readonly enabled: boolean;
```

- *Type:* boolean
- *Default:* false.

Whether the rule is active.

Disabled rules are ignored by ingestion. Defaults to false.

---

##### `priority`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="priority" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnRetentionRuleProps.property.priority"></a>

```typescript
public readonly priority: number;
```

- *Type:* number

Evaluation order: lower numbers are evaluated first and the first matching rule wins.

Omit to append after existing rules (PostHog assigns the next priority).

---

### CfnSamplingRuleProps <a name="CfnSamplingRuleProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps"></a>

A PostHog Logs sampling rule: reduces ingested log or span volume by sampling by severity, dropping matching records, or rate-limiting them.

Rules are evaluated in priority order and the first match wins.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { logs } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnSamplingRuleProps: logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.config">config</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Type-specific configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | User-visible label for this rule. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the sampling rule belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.ruleType">ruleType</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRulePropsRuleType</code> | Rule kind: `severity_sampling` (severity-based reduction), `path_drop` (drop matching records) or `rate_limit` (cap matching volume at ingestion). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.enabled">enabled</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Whether the rule is active. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.priority">priority</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Evaluation order: lower numbers are evaluated first and the first matching rule wins. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopeAttributeFilters">scopeAttributeFilters</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Optional predicates over string attributes as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. [{"key": "http.route", "op": "eq", "value": "/api"}]. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopePathPattern">scopePathPattern</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Optional regex matched against a path-like log attribute when present. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopeService">scopeService</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Optional legacy service-name scope. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.source">source</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRulePropsSource</code> | Record source the rule filters: `logs` (default) runs in the logs pipeline, `spans` in the traces pipeline. |

---

##### `config`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="config" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.config"></a>

```typescript
public readonly config: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Type-specific configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString).

path_drop: optional `filter_group` (AND/OR tree of property filters; every group needs at least one filter) and/or legacy `patterns` (regex list) with `match_attribute_key`. severity_sampling: `actions` per severity level and optional `always_keep`. rate_limit: either `logs_per_second` (1-1000000, optional `burst_logs`) or `kb_per_second` (1-1000000, optional `burst_kb`), not both, plus an optional `filter_group`.

---

##### `name`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="name" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.name"></a>

```typescript
public readonly name: string;
```

- *Type:* string

User-visible label for this rule.

---

##### `projectId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="projectId" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.projectId"></a>

```typescript
public readonly projectId: string;
```

- *Type:* string

ID of the PostHog project the sampling rule belongs to.

---

##### `ruleType`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="ruleType" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.ruleType"></a>

```typescript
public readonly ruleType: CfnSamplingRulePropsRuleType;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRulePropsRuleType

Rule kind: `severity_sampling` (severity-based reduction), `path_drop` (drop matching records) or `rate_limit` (cap matching volume at ingestion).

Span rules support `path_drop` and `rate_limit` only.

---

##### `enabled`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="enabled" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.enabled"></a>

```typescript
public readonly enabled: boolean;
```

- *Type:* boolean
- *Default:* false.

Whether the rule is active.

Disabled rules are ignored by ingestion. Defaults to false.

---

##### `priority`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="priority" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.priority"></a>

```typescript
public readonly priority: number;
```

- *Type:* number

Evaluation order: lower numbers are evaluated first and the first matching rule wins.

Logs and span rules have separate orders. Omit to append after existing rules (PostHog assigns the next priority).

---

##### `scopeAttributeFilters`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="scopeAttributeFilters" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopeAttributeFilters"></a>

```typescript
public readonly scopeAttributeFilters: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Optional predicates over string attributes as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. [{"key": "http.route", "op": "eq", "value": "/api"}].

---

##### `scopePathPattern`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="scopePathPattern" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopePathPattern"></a>

```typescript
public readonly scopePathPattern: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Optional regex matched against a path-like log attribute when present.

---

##### `scopeService`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="scopeService" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.scopeService"></a>

```typescript
public readonly scopeService: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Optional legacy service-name scope.

New rules should match with `filter_group` in Config instead.

---

##### `source`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="source" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRuleProps.property.source"></a>

```typescript
public readonly source: CfnSamplingRulePropsSource;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.CfnSamplingRulePropsSource

Record source the rule filters: `logs` (default) runs in the logs pipeline, `spans` in the traces pipeline.

Cannot be changed after creation.

### CfnSecretApiKeyProps <a name="CfnSecretApiKeyProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps"></a>

A PostHog project secret API key (phs_...): a project-scoped key with a fixed set of API scopes, for server-side use. PostHog returns the key value only when the key is created; the handler writes it to an AWS Secrets Manager secret you provide and never puts it in the resource model.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { projects } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnSecretApiKeyProps: projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.label">label</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Label that identifies the key in PostHog. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the secret API key belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.scopes">scopes</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Project-wide API scopes granted to the key, e.g. feature_flag:read or query:read. Project secret API keys do not honor object-level access controls, so a scope can access every resource of that type in the project. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.secretsManagerSecretArn">secretsManagerSecretArn</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ARN of an existing AWS Secrets Manager secret. |

---

##### `label`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="label" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.label"></a>

```typescript
public readonly label: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Label that identifies the key in PostHog.

---

##### `projectId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="projectId" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.projectId"></a>

```typescript
public readonly projectId: string;
```

- *Type:* string

ID of the PostHog project the secret API key belongs to.

---

##### `scopes`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="scopes" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.scopes"></a>

```typescript
public readonly scopes: string[];
```

- *Type:* string[]

Project-wide API scopes granted to the key, e.g. feature_flag:read or query:read. Project secret API keys do not honor object-level access controls, so a scope can access every resource of that type in the project.

---

##### `secretsManagerSecretArn`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="secretsManagerSecretArn" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.CfnSecretApiKeyProps.property.secretsManagerSecretArn"></a>

```typescript
public readonly secretsManagerSecretArn: string;
```

- *Type:* string

ARN of an existing AWS Secrets Manager secret.

On create the handler writes the key value (phs_...) to it as the secret string, because PostHog returns the value only once. The resource type execution role needs secretsmanager:PutSecretValue on the secret (and kms:GenerateDataKey/kms:Encrypt when it uses a customer managed KMS key). Changing it replaces the key.

---

### CfnSourceProps <a name="CfnSourceProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps"></a>

A PostHog data warehouse source: a connection to an external system (e.g. Postgres, Stripe, Hubspot) whose tables PostHog syncs into the data warehouse or queries live.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { dataWarehouse } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnSourceProps: dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.payload">payload</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Connection credentials and settings as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the source belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.sourceType">sourceType</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The source type, e.g. Postgres, Stripe, Hubspot. Changing it replaces the source. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.accessMethod">accessMethod</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourcePropsAccessMethod</code> | Connection mode: `warehouse` (import, the default) or `direct` (live query). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.autoSyncNewSchemas">autoSyncNewSchemas</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Automatically enable syncing for schemas discovered on this source after creation. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.autoSyncSchemaPatterns">autoSyncSchemaPatterns</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | fnmatch-style globs (`*` and `?`), e.g. `raw_*`, restricting which newly discovered schema names auto-sync. Empty means every new schema qualifies. Only used when AutoSyncNewSchemas is true. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.description">description</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Human-readable description. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.destinationIds">destinationIds</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | IDs of the destinations every table on this source writes to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.directQueryEnabled">directQueryEnabled</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Whether a synced source should also be live-queryable via direct connection. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.prefix">prefix</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Prefix added to the table names PostHog creates in HogQL. |

---

##### `payload`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="payload" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnSourceProps.property.payload"></a>

```typescript
public readonly payload: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Connection credentials and settings as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString).

Keys depend on SourceType. Add a 'schemas' array to pick which tables sync; omit it and every discovered table syncs with default settings. Write-only: never read back. Changing it later sends the new values (without 'schemas') as the source's job inputs.

---


- *Type:* string

ID of the PostHog project the source belongs to.


- *Type:* string

The source type, e.g. Postgres, Stripe, Hubspot. Changing it replaces the source.


Changing it replaces the source.

```typescript

```

- *Type:* boolean

Automatically enable syncing for schemas discovered on this source after creation.

Not supported for direct-query sources.

---


- *Type:* string[]

fnmatch-style globs (`*` and `?`), e.g. `raw_*`, restricting which newly discovered schema names auto-sync. Empty means every new schema qualifies. Only used when AutoSyncNewSchemas is true.

---

```typescript

```

- *Type:* string[]


- *Type:* string

Prefix added to the table names PostHog creates in HogQL.

Does not filter which tables are imported.

### CfnSubscriptionProps <a name="CfnSubscriptionProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps"></a>

A PostHog subscription: a scheduled delivery of an insight, a dashboard or an AI-generated report to email, Slack or Microsoft Teams.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript

const cfnSubscriptionProps: productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.property.frequency">frequency</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionPropsFrequency</code> | How often to deliver: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or `yearly`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the subscription belongs to. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.property.targetValue">targetValue</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Recipient(s): comma-separated email addresses for email, a Slack channel name or ID for slack, or a Microsoft Teams webhook URL for teams. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.property.aiPromptConfig">aiPromptConfig</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionAiPromptConfig</code> | Configuration for AI report subscriptions (only valid with Prompt). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionProps.property.bysetpos">bysetpos</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Position within the Byweekday set for monthly frequency (e.g. 1 for first, -1 for last). |

### CfnSubscriptionWindow <a name="CfnSubscriptionWindow" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow"></a>

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { productAnalytics } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnSubscriptionWindow: productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow = { ... }
```

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow.property.endDaysAgo">endDaysAgo</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Upper bound of the analysis window, in days before the run (0 = now). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow.property.mode">mode</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindowMode</code> | What the report analyzes each run: `since_last_sent` (default, everything since the previous scheduled delivery), `last_n_days` (a trailing window of StartDaysAgo days) or `days_ago_range` (from StartDaysAgo to EndDaysAgo days ago). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CfnSubscriptionWindow.property.startDaysAgo">startDaysAgo</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Lower bound of the analysis window, in days before the run. |

### CfnSuppressionRuleProps <a name="CfnSuppressionRuleProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps"></a>

A PostHog error tracking suppression rule: incoming exceptions that match a property filter are dropped (optionally sampled) before they create or update issues.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { errorTracking } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const cfnSuppressionRuleProps: errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the rule belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.filters">filters</a></code> | <code>string</code> | JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.orderKey">orderKey</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Evaluation priority among suppression rules; |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.samplingRate">samplingRate</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Probability that a matching event is dropped: 1.0 drops every match (default), 0.0 drops none, 0.5 drops half. |

---

##### `projectId`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="projectId" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.projectId"></a>

```typescript
public readonly projectId: string;
```

- *Type:* string

ID of the PostHog project the rule belongs to.

---

##### `filters`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="filters" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.filters"></a>

```typescript
public readonly filters: string;
```

- *Type:* string

JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString).

Property-group filter that defines which incoming error events are suppressed, e.g. {"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "$exception_values", "type": "event", "operator": "icontains", "value": "ResizeObserver loop"}]}. Omit it (or pass an empty values array) for a match-all rule.

---

##### `orderKey`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="orderKey" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.orderKey"></a>

```typescript
public readonly orderKey: number;
```

- *Type:* number

Evaluation priority among suppression rules;

lower is evaluated first.

---

##### `samplingRate`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="samplingRate" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.CfnSuppressionRuleProps.property.samplingRate"></a>

```typescript
public readonly samplingRate: number;
```

- *Type:* number

Probability that a matching event is dropped: 1.0 drops every match (default), 0.0 drops none, 0.5 drops half.

---

### CfnSurveyProps <a name="CfnSurveyProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps"></a>

A PostHog survey: questions shown to users in-app (popover or widget), on a hosted page, or collected through the API.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
const cfnSurveyProps: surveys.CfnSurveyProps = { ... }
```

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Survey name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.projectId">projectId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog project the survey belongs to. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.type">type</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyPropsType</code> | Survey type. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.appearance">appearance</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Appearance customization as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): colours, `position`, `submitButtonText`, `thankYouMessageHeader`, `whiteLabel` and so on. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.archived">archived</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Whether the survey is archived. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.baseLanguage">baseLanguage</a></code> | <code>string</code> | BCP-47 code of the language of the survey's untranslated text. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.conditions">conditions</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Display conditions as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): `url`, `urlMatchType`, `selector`, `deviceTypes`, `seenSurveyWaitPeriodInDays`, `events`, `actions` and so on. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.description">description</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Internal survey description. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.enableIframeEmbedding">enableIframeEmbedding</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Allow the hosted survey page to be embedded in an iframe. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.endDate">endDate</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ISO 8601 end time. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.iterationCount">iterationCount</a></code> | <code>number</code> | For a recurring schedule, how many times the survey is shown to a user. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.iterationFrequencyDays">iterationFrequencyDays</a></code> | <code>number</code> | For a recurring schedule, the number of days between survey iterations. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.linkedFlagId">linkedFlagId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of a feature flag linked to the survey: the survey is shown only to users with the flag enabled. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.linkedInsightId">linkedInsightId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of an insight linked to the survey. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.questions">questions</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Questions as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.repeatUntilStopped">repeatUntilStopped</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | For a recurring schedule, keep repeating until the survey is stopped (IterationCount is then ignored). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.responseSamplingInterval">responseSamplingInterval</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Length of the response sampling interval, in ResponseSamplingIntervalType units. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.responseSamplingStartDate">responseSamplingStartDate</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ISO 8601 start of response sampling. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.CfnSurveyProps.property.responsesLimit">responsesLimit</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Number of responses after which the survey stops automatically. |

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnTableProps.property.format">format</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.CfnTablePropsFormat</code> | File format of the objects the pattern matches. |

PostHog soft-deletes cohorts.

### DashboardSubscriptionOptions <a name="DashboardSubscriptionOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions"></a>

```typescript
import { productAnalytics } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const dashboardSubscriptionOptions: productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions.property.frequency">frequency</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.SubscriptionFrequency</code> | How often to deliver. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions.property.startDate">startDate</a></code> | <code>string \| Date</code> | When to start delivering. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions.property.target">target</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.SubscriptionTarget</code> | Where to deliver. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions.property.bysetpos">bysetpos</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Position within `byweekday` for monthly deliveries, e.g. 1 for the first or -1 for the last matching weekday of the month. |

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.DashboardSubscriptionOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog subscription when it is removed from the stack. |

### DomainOptions <a name="DomainOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions"></a>

Options for claiming a domain in an organization.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { organizations } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const domainOptions: organizations.DomainOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.domainName">domainName</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The email domain to claim, e.g. `example.com`. Changing it replaces the domain, which then needs verifying again. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.hostedZone">hostedZone</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone</code> | Route 53 hosted zone for the domain. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.jitProvisioning">jitProvisioning</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Let users with a verified email address on this domain join the organization automatically when they log in with SSO. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog domain when it is removed from the stack. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.ssoEnforcement">ssoEnforcement</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.SsoProvider</code> | Login method users on this domain must use. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.verificationRecordTtl">verificationRecordTtl</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | TTL of the verification TXT record. |

---

##### `domainName`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="domainName" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.domainName"></a>

```typescript
public readonly domainName: string;
```

- *Type:* string

The email domain to claim, e.g. `example.com`. Changing it replaces the domain, which then needs verifying again.

---

##### `hostedZone`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="hostedZone" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.hostedZone"></a>

```typescript
public readonly hostedZone: IHostedZone;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone
- *Default:* no record; create it yourself from `verificationChallenge`

Route 53 hosted zone for the domain.

When set, the TXT record PostHog
checks to verify the domain (`_posthog-challenge.<domain>`) is created in
it. Verification itself is triggered in PostHog once the record has
propagated.

---

```typescript

```

- *Type:* boolean
- *Default:* false

Let users with a verified email address on this domain join the organization automatically when they log in with SSO.

---

##### `removalPolicy`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="removalPolicy" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.DomainOptions.property.removalPolicy"></a>

```typescript
public readonly removalPolicy: RemovalPolicy;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy
- *Default:* RemovalPolicy.DESTROY

What happens to the PostHog domain when it is removed from the stack.

---


- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.SsoProvider
- *Default:* no enforcement


#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { llmAnalytics } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const hogEvaluationOptions: llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Name of the evaluation, up to 400 characters. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.conditions">conditions</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.EvaluationCondition[]</code> | Trigger conditions. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.description">description</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Description of what the evaluation checks. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.directoryId">directoryId</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ID of the PostHog directory (folder) containing the evaluation. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.enabled">enabled</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Run the evaluation automatically on new matching input. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.output">output</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.EvaluationOutput</code> | Output format and settings. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog evaluation when it is removed from the stack. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.settle">settle</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.SettleStrategy</code> | When a trace or session is evaluated. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.target">target</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.EvaluationTarget</code> | What the evaluation runs on. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.HogEvaluationOptions.property.source">source</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The Hog source code. |

```typescript

```

```typescript
import { experiments } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const meanMetricOptions: experiments.MeanMetricOptions = { ... }
```

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.conversionWindow">conversionWindow</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | Only count events within this window after a user's first exposure. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.goal">goal</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MetricGoal</code> | Whether higher or lower values mean success. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Human-readable metric name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.uuid">uuid</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Stable metric UUID. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.action">action</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.IAction</code> | Action to match instead of a single event. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.event">event</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Event name, e.g. `$pageview` or `purchase_completed`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.properties">properties</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.core.PropertyFilter[]</code> | Event property filters narrowing which events count. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.math">math</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MetricMath</code> | How to aggregate the events. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.mathGroupTypeIndex">mathGroupTypeIndex</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Group type index (0-4) to count. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.mathHogql">mathHogql</a></code> | <code>string</code> | HogQL aggregation expression. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.mathProperty">mathProperty</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Numeric event property to aggregate, e.g. `revenue`. Required for `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN` and `MAX`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.lowerBoundPercentile">lowerBoundPercentile</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Winsorization lower bound, as a fraction in [0, 1] (e.g. 0.01 for the 1st percentile). Per-user values below it are clamped. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MeanMetricOptions.property.upperBoundPercentile">upperBoundPercentile</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Winsorization upper bound, as a fraction in [0, 1] (e.g. 0.99 for the 99th percentile). Per-user values above it are clamped. |

The events a mean metric, or one side of a ratio metric, aggregates.

exactly one of `event` and `action`.

```typescript
import { experiments } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.MetricSource.property.action">action</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.IAction</code> | Action to match instead of a single event. |

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.MonitoredInsightAlert.property.calculationInterval">calculationInterval</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.AlertCalculationInterval</code> | How often the alert is checked. |

### PostHogProjectProps <a name="PostHogProjectProps" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps"></a>

Properties for a PostHogProject.

Every `ProjectOptions` setting is passed through to the project. The
pattern only changes these defaults: exception and web vitals autocapture
are on, and new insights exclude internal and test users when there are
test account filters.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { patterns } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const postHogProjectProps: patterns.PostHogProjectProps = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Project name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.anonymizeIps">anonymizeIps</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Drop the IP address from every ingested event. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.appUrls">appUrls</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | URLs of the sites and apps that send data to this project (used by the toolbar and heatmaps). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.autocaptureExceptions">autocaptureExceptions</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture JavaScript exceptions automatically. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.autocaptureOptOut">autocaptureOptOut</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Turn off posthog-js autocapture (clicks, page views). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.autocaptureWebVitals">autocaptureWebVitals</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture Core Web Vitals automatically. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.baseCurrency">baseCurrency</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ISO 4217 currency code used for revenue analytics, e.g. `EUR`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.businessModel">businessModel</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.BusinessModel</code> | Whether the project serves business or consumer customers. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.captureConsoleLogs">captureConsoleLogs</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture browser console logs with session replays. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.captureDeadClicks">captureDeadClicks</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture clicks that had no effect (dead clicks). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.capturePerformance">capturePerformance</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture performance timing and network requests. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.dataAttributes">dataAttributes</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Element attributes that posthog-js uses as action identifiers, e.g. `data-attr`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.heatmaps">heatmaps</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Record heatmaps on pages that use posthog-js. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.pathCleaningFilters">pathCleaningFilters</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.PathCleaningRule[]</code> | Rules that collapse dynamic path segments before URLs are shown in paths. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.personDisplayNameProperties">personDisplayNameProperties</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Person properties, in order, used to show a person's display name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.productDescription">productDescription</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Short description of the product, used as context by PostHog AI features. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.recordingDomains">recordingDomains</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Origins allowed to record session replays and heatmaps. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog project when it is removed from the stack or replaced. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.sessionRecording">sessionRecording</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Record session replays. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.sessionRecordingMinimumDuration">sessionRecordingMinimumDuration</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | Don't save sessions shorter than this. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.sessionRecordingRetentionPeriod">sessionRecordingRetentionPeriod</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.RecordingRetentionPeriod</code> | How long new session recordings are kept. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.sessionRecordingSampleRate">sessionRecordingSampleRate</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Fraction of sessions to record, between 0 and 1 with at most two decimals (0.1 records 10% of sessions). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.surveys">surveys</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Show surveys via posthog-js. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.tags">tags</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Labels on the project. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.testAccountFilters">testAccountFilters</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.core.PropertyFilter[]</code> | Property filters that identify internal and test traffic, excluded from insights when "filter out internal and test users" is on. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.testAccountFiltersDefaultChecked">testAccountFiltersDefaultChecked</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Make new insights exclude internal and test users by default. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.timezone">timezone</a></code> | <code>string</code> | IANA timezone used for date filters and reporting, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.weekStartDay">weekStartDay</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.WeekStartDay</code> | First day of the week for date range filters. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.organization">organization</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.IOrganization</code> | The organization to create the project in. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.excludeLocalhost">excludeLocalhost</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Add a test account filter that excludes events sent from `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` (`$host not_regex ^(localhost\|127\.0\.0\.1)($\|:)`). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.internalEmailDomain">internalEmailDomain</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Your company's email domain, e.g. `example.com`. Adds a test account filter that excludes persons whose email contains `@<domain>` (`email not_icontains. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProps.property.outputs">outputs</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Add stack outputs for the project ID, the public project API key, the API host, the ingestion host and (with `secretApiKey`) the ARN of the secret that holds the key. |


- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy
- *Default:* RemovalPolicy.RETAIN

What happens to the PostHog project when it is removed from the stack or replaced.

**Deleting a project deletes all its data** (events, persons,
recordings, insights, flags, ...) and cannot be undone, so the default
keeps it. Setting `RemovalPolicy.DESTROY` adds a synth warning.

### PostHogProjectProxyOptions <a name="PostHogProjectProxyOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions"></a>

A PostHog managed reverse proxy for a `PostHogProject`.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { patterns } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const postHogProjectProxyOptions: patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.domainName">domainName</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The subdomain to proxy PostHog through, e.g. `e.example.com`. Pick a name that doesn't look like analytics (avoid `posthog`, `analytics`, `tracking`), so ad blockers don't block it. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.hostedZone">hostedZone</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone</code> | Route 53 hosted zone for the subdomain. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.rootRedirectUrl">rootRedirectUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to. |

---

##### `domainName`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="domainName" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.domainName"></a>

```typescript
public readonly domainName: string;
```

- *Type:* string

The subdomain to proxy PostHog through, e.g. `e.example.com`. Pick a name that doesn't look like analytics (avoid `posthog`, `analytics`, `tracking`), so ad blockers don't block it.

---

##### `hostedZone`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="hostedZone" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.hostedZone"></a>

```typescript
public readonly hostedZone: IHostedZone;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone

Route 53 hosted zone for the subdomain.

The CNAME record that points
`domainName` at PostHog is created in it.

---

##### `rootRedirectUrl`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="rootRedirectUrl" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogProjectProxyOptions.property.rootRedirectUrl"></a>

```typescript
public readonly rootRedirectUrl: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* no redirect

HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to.

Must be on
the same registrable domain as the proxy.

---

### PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions <a name="PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions"></a>

Options shared by `PostHogResourceTypes` and `PostHogResourceTypeRegistration`.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { patterns } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const postHogResourceTypeConfigOptions: patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.apiKeySecret">apiKeySecret</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_secretsmanager.ISecret</code> | The Secrets Manager secret holding the PostHog personal API key (`phx_...`). It is passed to the type configuration as a dynamic reference (`{{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}`) that CloudFormation resolves each time it runs a handler, so the key never appears in a template. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.apiKeySecretJsonField">apiKeySecretJsonField</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The JSON key holding the API key, when the secret is a JSON object. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.baseUrl">baseUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The PostHog API host: `https://eu.posthog.com` for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.handlerSecretArns">handlerSecretArns</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | ARNs (wildcards allowed) of the Secrets Manager secrets the handlers may write one-time values into (project secret API keys, SCIM tokens). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.logGroup">logGroup</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_logs.ILogGroup</code> | Log group for handler logs. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.logRetention">logRetention</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_logs.RetentionDays</code> | Retention for the log groups this construct creates. |

---

##### `apiKeySecret`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="apiKeySecret" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceTypeConfigOptions.property.apiKeySecret"></a>


The Secrets Manager secret holding the PostHog personal API key (`phx_...`). It is passed to the type configuration as a dynamic reference (`{{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}`) that CloudFormation resolves each time it runs a handler, so the key never appears in a template.


- *Type:* string
- *Default:* the whole secret string is the API key

The JSON key holding the API key, when the secret is a JSON object.


- *Type:* string
- *Default:* PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com)

The PostHog API host: `https://eu.posthog.com` for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.


### ProjectOptions <a name="ProjectOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions"></a>

Options for creating a project in an organization.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { organizations } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const projectOptions: organizations.ProjectOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Project name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.anonymizeIps">anonymizeIps</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Drop the IP address from every ingested event. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.appUrls">appUrls</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | URLs of the sites and apps that send data to this project (used by the toolbar and heatmaps). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.autocaptureExceptions">autocaptureExceptions</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture JavaScript exceptions automatically. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.autocaptureOptOut">autocaptureOptOut</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Turn off posthog-js autocapture (clicks, page views). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.autocaptureWebVitals">autocaptureWebVitals</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture Core Web Vitals automatically. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.baseCurrency">baseCurrency</a></code> | <code>string</code> | ISO 4217 currency code used for revenue analytics, e.g. `EUR`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.businessModel">businessModel</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.BusinessModel</code> | Whether the project serves business or consumer customers. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.captureConsoleLogs">captureConsoleLogs</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture browser console logs with session replays. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.captureDeadClicks">captureDeadClicks</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture clicks that had no effect (dead clicks). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.capturePerformance">capturePerformance</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Capture performance timing and network requests. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.dataAttributes">dataAttributes</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Element attributes that posthog-js uses as action identifiers, e.g. `data-attr`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.heatmaps">heatmaps</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Record heatmaps on pages that use posthog-js. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.pathCleaningFilters">pathCleaningFilters</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.PathCleaningRule[]</code> | Rules that collapse dynamic path segments before URLs are shown in paths. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.personDisplayNameProperties">personDisplayNameProperties</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Person properties, in order, used to show a person's display name. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.productDescription">productDescription</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Short description of the product, used as context by PostHog AI features. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.recordingDomains">recordingDomains</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Origins allowed to record session replays and heatmaps. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog project when it is removed from the stack or replaced. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.sessionRecording">sessionRecording</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Record session replays. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.sessionRecordingMinimumDuration">sessionRecordingMinimumDuration</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | Don't save sessions shorter than this. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.sessionRecordingRetentionPeriod">sessionRecordingRetentionPeriod</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.RecordingRetentionPeriod</code> | How long new session recordings are kept. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.sessionRecordingSampleRate">sessionRecordingSampleRate</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Fraction of sessions to record, between 0 and 1 with at most two decimals (0.1 records 10% of sessions). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.surveys">surveys</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Show surveys via posthog-js. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.tags">tags</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Labels on the project. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.testAccountFilters">testAccountFilters</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.core.PropertyFilter[]</code> | Property filters that identify internal and test traffic, excluded from insights when "filter out internal and test users" is on. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProjectOptions.property.testAccountFiltersDefaultChecked">testAccountFiltersDefaultChecked</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Make new insights exclude internal and test users by default. |


```typescript
import { llmAnalytics } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const providerKeyOptions: llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions = { ... }
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.apiKey">apiKey</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.SecretValue</code> | The provider API key. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.name">name</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Display name of the key, up to 255 characters. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.provider">provider</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.Provider</code> | LLM provider the key is for. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.apiVersion">apiVersion</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Azure API version, up to 20 characters. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.azureEndpoint">azureEndpoint</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Azure endpoint URL. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.baseUrl">baseUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Public HTTPS base URL of the API. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog provider key when it is removed from the stack. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.setAsActive">setAsActive</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Make this the project's active key for its provider when it is created or updated. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.systemOneModel">systemOneModel</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Model ID served by the System One endpoint, up to 100 characters. |

---

##### `apiKey`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="apiKey" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.apiKey"></a>

```typescript
public readonly apiKey: SecretValue;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.SecretValue

The provider API key.

Pass a Secrets Manager reference
(`SecretValue.secretsManager()`), so it is rendered as a dynamic
reference and never appears in the template. (CloudFormation only
resolves `ssm-secure` references for a fixed list of AWS resource
types, so `SecretValue.ssmSecure()` does not work here.)
Changing it rotates the key.

---

##### `name`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="name" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.name"></a>

```typescript
public readonly name: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Display name of the key, up to 255 characters.

---

```typescript
public readonly provider: Provider;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.Provider

LLM provider the key is for.

Changing it replaces the key.

---

##### `apiVersion`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="apiVersion" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.apiVersion"></a>

```typescript
public readonly apiVersion: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* PostHog default

Azure API version, up to 20 characters.

Only for `Provider.AZURE_OPENAI`
and Foundry-served `Provider.ANTHROPIC` keys.

---

##### `azureEndpoint`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="azureEndpoint" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.azureEndpoint"></a>

```typescript
public readonly azureEndpoint: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* none (for Anthropic: a key from the Anthropic API)

Azure endpoint URL.

Required for `Provider.AZURE_OPENAI`. For
`Provider.ANTHROPIC`, set it to the endpoint of a Microsoft Foundry
resource (e.g. `https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com/`) for a key
served by Foundry. Not allowed for other providers.

---

##### `baseUrl`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="baseUrl" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.baseUrl"></a>

```typescript
public readonly baseUrl: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* none

Public HTTPS base URL of the API.

Required for
`Provider.OPENAI_COMPATIBLE` and `Provider.SYSTEM_ONE` (for System One,
end it before `/systemone`); not allowed for other providers.

---

##### `removalPolicy`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="removalPolicy" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.removalPolicy"></a>

```typescript
public readonly removalPolicy: RemovalPolicy;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy
- *Default:* RemovalPolicy.DESTROY

What happens to the PostHog provider key when it is removed from the stack.

PostHog hard-deletes provider keys; evaluations pinned to the key
lose it.

---

##### `setAsActive`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="setAsActive" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.setAsActive"></a>

```typescript
public readonly setAsActive: boolean;
```

- *Type:* boolean
- *Default:* false

Make this the project's active key for its provider when it is created or updated.

---

##### `systemOneModel`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="systemOneModel" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.llmAnalytics.ProviderKeyOptions.property.systemOneModel"></a>

```typescript
public readonly systemOneModel: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* none

Model ID served by the System One endpoint, up to 100 characters.

Required for `Provider.SYSTEM_ONE`; not allowed for other providers.

---

### ProxyRecordOptions <a name="ProxyRecordOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions"></a>

Options for creating a managed reverse proxy in an organization.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { organizations } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const proxyRecordOptions: organizations.ProxyRecordOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.domainName">domainName</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The subdomain to proxy PostHog through, e.g. `e.example.com`. Must be a subdomain you control. Changing it replaces the proxy. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.hostedZone">hostedZone</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone</code> | Route 53 hosted zone for the subdomain. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.recordTtl">recordTtl</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | TTL of the CNAME record. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog proxy when it is removed from the stack. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.rootRedirectUrl">rootRedirectUrl</a></code> | <code>string</code> | HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to. |

---

##### `domainName`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="domainName" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.domainName"></a>

```typescript
public readonly domainName: string;
```

- *Type:* string

The subdomain to proxy PostHog through, e.g. `e.example.com`. Must be a subdomain you control. Changing it replaces the proxy.

---

##### `hostedZone`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="hostedZone" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.hostedZone"></a>

```typescript
public readonly hostedZone: IHostedZone;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.aws_route53.IHostedZone
- *Default:* no record; create it yourself from `targetCname`

Route 53 hosted zone for the subdomain.

When set, the CNAME record from
`domainName` to `targetCname` is created in it.

---

##### `recordTtl`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="recordTtl" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.recordTtl"></a>

```typescript
public readonly recordTtl: Duration;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.Duration
- *Default:* Duration.minutes(5)

TTL of the CNAME record.

---

##### `removalPolicy`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="removalPolicy" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.removalPolicy"></a>

```typescript
public readonly removalPolicy: RemovalPolicy;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy
- *Default:* RemovalPolicy.DESTROY

What happens to the PostHog proxy when it is removed from the stack.

---

##### `rootRedirectUrl`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="rootRedirectUrl" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.organizations.ProxyRecordOptions.property.rootRedirectUrl"></a>

```typescript
public readonly rootRedirectUrl: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* no redirect

HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to.

Must be on
the same registrable domain as the proxy.

---

### ReleaseCondition <a name="ReleaseCondition" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition"></a>

One release condition group of a feature flag.

A user matches the group
when they match every property condition (and the cohort, if set); the
flag is then on for `rolloutPercentage` percent of the matching users.
The flag is on when any group matches.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { featureFlags } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const releaseCondition: featureFlags.ReleaseCondition = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.cohort">cohort</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.ICohort</code> | Only match members of this cohort. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.properties">properties</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.core.PropertyFilter[]</code> | Person, group or other property conditions. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.rolloutPercentage">rolloutPercentage</a></code> | <code>number</code> | Percentage (0-100) of matching users the flag is on for. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.variant">variant</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Serve this variant to everyone matching the group, instead of the variant split. |

---

##### `cohort`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="cohort" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.cohort"></a>

```typescript
public readonly cohort: ICohort;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.ICohort
- *Default:* no cohort condition

Only match members of this cohort.

---

##### `properties`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="properties" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.properties"></a>

```typescript
public readonly properties: PropertyFilter[];
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.core.PropertyFilter[]
- *Default:* none (every user matches)

Person, group or other property conditions.

All must match.

---

##### `rolloutPercentage`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="rolloutPercentage" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.rolloutPercentage"></a>

```typescript
public readonly rolloutPercentage: number;
```

- *Type:* number
- *Default:* 100

Percentage (0-100) of matching users the flag is on for.

---

##### `variant`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="variant" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ReleaseCondition.property.variant"></a>

```typescript
public readonly variant: string;
```

- *Type:* string
- *Default:* the flag's variant split

Serve this variant to everyone matching the group, instead of the variant split.

Must be the key of one of the flag's `variants`.
