### SecretApiKeyOptions <a name="SecretApiKeyOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions"></a>

Options for creating a project secret API key (`project.addSecretApiKey()`).

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { projects } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const secretApiKeyOptions: projects.SecretApiKeyOptions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.label">label</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Label that identifies the key in PostHog. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.scopes">scopes</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyScope[]</code> | API scopes granted to the key. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.removalPolicy">removalPolicy</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy</code> | What happens to the PostHog key when it is removed from the stack. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.secret">secret</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.aws_secretsmanager.ISecret</code> | Secrets Manager secret that receives the key value (`phs_...`). PostHog returns the value only once, when the key is created, and the resource type writes it to this secret. The resource type's execution role needs `secretsmanager:PutSecretValue` on it (and `kms:GenerateDataKey` / `kms:Encrypt` on its key when it uses a customer managed KMS key). |

---

##### `label`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="label" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.label"></a>

```typescript
public readonly label: string;
```

- *Type:* string

Label that identifies the key in PostHog.

1 to 40 characters.

---

##### `scopes`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="scopes" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.scopes"></a>

```typescript
public readonly scopes: SecretApiKeyScope[];
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyScope[]

API scopes granted to the key.

At least one. The key can access every
object of a granted type in the project.

---

##### `removalPolicy`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="removalPolicy" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.removalPolicy"></a>

```typescript
public readonly removalPolicy: RemovalPolicy;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.RemovalPolicy
- *Default:* RemovalPolicy.DESTROY

What happens to the PostHog key when it is removed from the stack.

A
secret created by this construct gets the same policy, so a retained key
keeps its value.

---

##### `secret`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="secret" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyOptions.property.secret"></a>

```typescript
public readonly secret: ISecret;
```

- *Type:* aws-cdk-lib.aws_secretsmanager.ISecret
- *Default:* a new secret is created, tagged `posthog-cdk:handler-writable` so the execution roles of `patterns.PostHogResourceTypes` may write it

Secrets Manager secret that receives the key value (`phs_...`). PostHog returns the value only once, when the key is created, and the resource type writes it to this secret. The resource type's execution role needs `secretsmanager:PutSecretValue` on it (and `kms:GenerateDataKey` / `kms:Encrypt` on its key when it uses a customer managed KMS key).

Changing the secret replaces the key in PostHog.

---

### SuppressionRuleOptions <a name="SuppressionRuleOptions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.SuppressionRuleOptions"></a>


#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.SuppressionRuleOptions.property.filters">filters</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter</code> | Which incoming exceptions are suppressed. |

### SurveyConditions <a name="SurveyConditions" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions"></a>

When and where an in-app survey is shown.

#### Initializer <a name="Initializer" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.Initializer"></a>

```typescript
import { surveys } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

const surveyConditions: surveys.SurveyConditions = { ... }
```

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.deviceTypes">deviceTypes</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyDeviceType[]</code> | Device types to match. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.deviceTypesMatchType">deviceTypesMatchType</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.UrlMatchType</code> | How `deviceTypes` is compared. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.events">events</a></code> | <code>string[]</code> | Show the survey when one of these events is captured. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.linkedFlagVariant">linkedFlagVariant</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Show the survey only to users on this variant of the linked flag. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.repeatedActivation">repeatedActivation</a></code> | <code>boolean</code> | Show the survey every time one of `events` is captured, not just once. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.seenSurveyWaitPeriod">seenSurveyWaitPeriod</a></code> | <code>aws-cdk-lib.Duration</code> | Don't show the survey to users who saw any survey within this period (whole days). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.selector">selector</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Show the survey only when an element matching this CSS selector is on the page. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.url">url</a></code> | <code>string</code> | Page URL to match. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.urlMatchType">urlMatchType</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.UrlMatchType</code> | How `url` is compared. |

---

##### `deviceTypes`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="deviceTypes" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyConditions.property.deviceTypes"></a>

```typescript
public readonly deviceTypes: SurveyDeviceType[];
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.SurveyDeviceType[]
- *Default:* all devices

Device types to match.

```typescript
public readonly deviceTypesMatchType: UrlMatchType;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.surveys.UrlMatchType
- *Default:* UrlMatchType.EXACT

How `deviceTypes` is compared.

---

### BatchExportDestination <a name="BatchExportDestination" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination"></a>

Where a batch export writes. Create one with the static methods.

Non-secret settings are rendered into `DestinationConfig`; credentials
(`SecretValue`) into the write-only `DestinationSecretConfig` as dynamic
references, so they never appear in the template. The destination type
cannot be changed after the batch export is created: changing it fails
the update, so replace the construct (give it a new ID) instead.


#### Static Functions <a name="Static Functions" id="Static Functions"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.azureBlob">azureBlob</a></code> | Export to Azure Blob Storage. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.bigQuery">bigQuery</a></code> | Export to Google BigQuery. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.databricks">databricks</a></code> | Export to Databricks. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.postgres">postgres</a></code> | Export to Postgres. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.raw">raw</a></code> | Any destination, with the config as PostHog expects it. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.redshift">redshift</a></code> | Export to Amazon Redshift. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.s3">s3</a></code> | Export to Amazon S3. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.batchExports.BatchExportDestination.snowflake">snowflake</a></code> | Export to Snowflake. |

---

### CohortCriteria <a name="CohortCriteria" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria"></a>

Who belongs to a cohort: person property conditions, behavioral conditions and membership of other cohorts, combined with `all()` (AND) and `any()` (OR).

*Example*

```typescript
CohortCriteria.all(
  CohortCriteria.personProperty({ key: 'email', value: '@example.com', operator: PropertyOperator.ICONTAINS }),
  CohortCriteria.performedEvent('$pageview', { within: Duration.days(30) }),
);
```



#### Static Functions <a name="Static Functions" id="Static Functions"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.all">all</a></code> | Every one of the criteria must match (AND). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.any">any</a></code> | Any one of the criteria may match (OR). |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.didNotPerformEvent">didNotPerformEvent</a></code> | The person did not perform the event in the time window. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.fromJson">fromJson</a></code> | A condition in PostHog's raw JSON shape, for conditions this builder doesn't model, e.g. `{ key: '$pageview', type: 'behavioral', value: 'performed_event_regularly', ... }`. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.inCohort">inCohort</a></code> | The person is a member of the cohort. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.notInCohort">notInCohort</a></code> | The person is not a member of the cohort. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.performedAction">performedAction</a></code> | The person performed the action at least once in the time window. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.productAnalytics.CohortCriteria.performedEvent">performedEvent</a></code> | The person performed the event at least once in the time window. |

### ErrorFilter <a name="ErrorFilter" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter"></a>

Which exceptions an error tracking rule or alert matches: exception type, message, stack frame and event property conditions, combined with AND/OR.

```ts
const filter = ErrorFilter.all(
  ErrorFilter.exceptionType(PropertyOperator.EXACT, ['TypeError']),
  ErrorFilter.any(
    ErrorFilter.exceptionMessage(PropertyOperator.ICONTAINS, 'timeout'),
    ErrorFilter.stackFrameSource(PropertyOperator.REGEX, '^src/payments/'),
  ),
);
```

#### Methods <a name="Methods" id="Methods"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.render">render</a></code> | Renders the filter as PostHog's property group JSON: `{"type": "AND" \| "OR", "values": [...]}`. A single condition is wrapped in an AND group. |

---

##### `render` <a name="render" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.render"></a>

```typescript
public render(): any
```

Renders the filter as PostHog's property group JSON: `{"type": "AND" | "OR", "values": [...]}`. A single condition is wrapped in an AND group.

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.all">all</a></code> | Matches when every condition matches. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.any">any</a></code> | Matches when any condition matches. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.exceptionMessage">exceptionMessage</a></code> | Matches exceptions whose message satisfies the condition. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.exceptionProperty">exceptionProperty</a></code> | Matches on one of the exception properties PostHog sets. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.exceptionType">exceptionType</a></code> | Matches exceptions whose type (class name) satisfies the condition. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.property">property</a></code> | Matches on any event, person or other property, e.g. `$lib` or a custom event property. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.stackFrameFunction">stackFrameFunction</a></code> | Matches exceptions with a stack frame whose function name satisfies the condition. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.errorTracking.ErrorFilter.stackFrameSource">stackFrameSource</a></code> | Matches exceptions with a stack frame whose source file satisfies the condition. |

### LogFilter <a name="LogFilter" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.LogFilter"></a>

Which log records an alert or rule matches: message, attribute and resource attribute conditions, combined with AND/OR.

```ts
const filter = LogFilter.all(
  LogFilter.serviceName(PropertyOperator.EXACT, 'api'),
  LogFilter.any(
    LogFilter.message(PropertyOperator.ICONTAINS, 'timeout'),
    LogFilter.attribute('http.route', PropertyOperator.EXACT, '/health'),
  ),
);
```

#### Methods <a name="Methods" id="Methods"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.LogFilter.render">render</a></code> | Renders the filter as PostHog's property group JSON, in the two-level shape the PostHog UI writes: an outer AND group whose values are groups, e.g. `{"type": "AND", "values": [{"type": "OR", "values": [...]}]}`. |

---

##### `render` <a name="render" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.logs.LogFilter.render"></a>

```typescript
public render(): any
```

Renders the filter as PostHog's property group JSON, in the two-level shape the PostHog UI writes: an outer AND group whose values are groups, e.g. `{"type": "AND", "values": [{"type": "OR", "values": [...]}]}`.

### PostHogResourceType <a name="PostHogResourceType" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceType"></a>

A PostHog CloudFormation resource type (`PostHog::Service::Resource`) that `PostHogResourceTypes` can register.

The catalog mirrors `docs/resources.json` and the schemas in the
`posthog-*` resource type projects: the type name, the project directory
(which is also the name of the handler package `<packageName>.zip` that
`cfn submit --dry-run` produces) and the IAM actions the type's handlers
need.


#### Static Functions <a name="Static Functions" id="Static Functions"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceType.all">all</a></code> | Every PostHog resource type, in catalog order. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.patterns.PostHogResourceType.fromTypeName">fromTypeName</a></code> | Look up a type by its CloudFormation type name, e.g. `PostHog::FeatureFlags::FeatureFlag`. |

---


### Recurrence <a name="Recurrence" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence"></a>

A repeating schedule for a scheduled change.

Only `enable()` and
`disable()` operations can recur.


#### Static Functions <a name="Static Functions" id="Static Functions"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.cron">cron</a></code> | Repeat on a cron expression (five fields, e.g. `0 9 * * 1-5`), evaluated in the project's time zone. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.every">every</a></code> | Repeat at a fixed interval, starting at the change's `at` time. |

---

##### `cron` <a name="cron" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.cron"></a>

```typescript
import { featureFlags } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

featureFlags.Recurrence.cron(expression: string)
```

Repeat on a cron expression (five fields, e.g. `0 9 * * 1-5`), evaluated in the project's time zone.

###### `expression`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="expression" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.cron.parameter.expression"></a>

- *Type:* string

---

##### `every` <a name="every" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.every"></a>

```typescript
import { featureFlags } from '@posthog/cdk-constructs'

featureFlags.Recurrence.every(interval: RecurrenceInterval)
```

Repeat at a fixed interval, starting at the change's `at` time.

###### `interval`<sup>Required</sup> <a name="interval" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.every.parameter.interval"></a>

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.RecurrenceInterval

---

#### Properties <a name="Properties" id="Properties"></a>

| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.property.cronExpression">cronExpression</a></code> | <code>string</code> | The cron expression, if any. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.property.interval">interval</a></code> | <code>@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.RecurrenceInterval</code> | The fixed interval, if any. |

---

##### `cronExpression`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="cronExpression" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.property.cronExpression"></a>

```typescript
public readonly cronExpression: string;
```

- *Type:* string

The cron expression, if any.

---

##### `interval`<sup>Optional</sup> <a name="interval" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.Recurrence.property.interval"></a>

```typescript
public readonly interval: RecurrenceInterval;
```

- *Type:* @posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.RecurrenceInterval

The fixed interval, if any.

---


### ScheduledOperation <a name="ScheduledOperation" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation"></a>

A change to apply to a feature flag at a scheduled time.


#### Static Functions <a name="Static Functions" id="Static Functions"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation.addReleaseCondition">addReleaseCondition</a></code> | Append a release condition group to the flag's existing ones. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation.disable">disable</a></code> | Disable the flag. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation.enable">enable</a></code> | Enable the flag. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation.rolloutTo">rolloutTo</a></code> | Roll the flag out to `percentage` percent of all users, by appending a release condition with no property conditions. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.featureFlags.ScheduledOperation.updateVariants">updateVariants</a></code> | Replace the flag's variants, and optionally its payloads (any JSON value per variant key). |

---

### SourceConfig <a name="SourceConfig" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceConfig"></a>

The type and connection settings of a data warehouse source. Create one with the static methods.

Everything is sent in the write-only `Payload`, so secrets (`SecretValue`)
are rendered as dynamic references and never appear in plain text.
PostHog never returns the payload, so connection changes made outside
CloudFormation are not detected as drift.

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceConfig.postgres">postgres</a></code> | A Postgres database. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceConfig.raw">raw</a></code> | Any source type, with the payload as PostHog expects it. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceConfig.stripe">stripe</a></code> | A Stripe account. |

---

| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.cdp.HogFunctionType.TRANSFORMATION_LOG">TRANSFORMATION_LOG</a></code> | Transformation that only logs (no changes to events). |

### SecretApiKeyScope <a name="SecretApiKeyScope" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.projects.SecretApiKeyScope"></a>

A PostHog API scope that can be granted to a project secret API key.

The values are the API scopes in PostHog's OpenAPI spec. PostHog decides
which of them a project secret API key may hold and rejects the others when
the key is created. A key is project-wide: it does not honour per-object
access controls.

### SourceSyncType <a name="SourceSyncType" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType"></a>

How PostHog syncs a source table.

#### Members <a name="Members" id="Members"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.FULL_REFRESH">FULL_REFRESH</a></code> | Re-import the whole table on every sync. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.INCREMENTAL">INCREMENTAL</a></code> | Import rows whose incremental field advanced, updating existing rows. |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.APPEND">APPEND</a></code> | Append rows whose incremental field advanced. |

---

##### `FULL_REFRESH` <a name="FULL_REFRESH" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.FULL_REFRESH"></a>

Re-import the whole table on every sync.

---


##### `INCREMENTAL` <a name="INCREMENTAL" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.INCREMENTAL"></a>

Import rows whose incremental field advanced, updating existing rows.

---


##### `APPEND` <a name="APPEND" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.dataWarehouse.SourceSyncType.APPEND"></a>

Append rows whose incremental field advanced.

---


### StatsMethod <a name="StatsMethod" id="@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.StatsMethod"></a>

Statistical method used to analyse the experiment.

#### Members <a name="Members" id="Members"></a>

| **Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| <code><a href="#@posthog/cdk-constructs.experiments.StatsMethod.BAYESIAN">BAYESIAN</a></code> | Bayesian analysis (win probabilities and credible intervals). |
